story.zh: 大业未成，诸葛亮决定再度出师北伐。
story.en: With the great enterprise yet unfulfilled, Zhuge Liang resolved to launch another Northern Expedition.

trigger.zh: 成都、汉中、武都属刘禅，洛阳、长安属曹叡，天水属刘禅或曹叡；诸葛亮、司马懿、张郃存活且属正确势力。
trigger.en: Chengdu, Hanzhong, and Wudou belong to Liu Shan, Luoyang and Changan belong to Cao Rui, Tianshui belongs to either Liu Shan or Cao Rui. Zhuge Liang, Sima Yi, and Zhang He are alive and belong to their correct Factions.

participate.zh: 【身属刘禅势力且不为刘禅、费祎、蒋琬、杨仪、李严、王平、张嶷、吴班、吴懿】或【身属曹叡势力且不为曹叡、孙礼】
participate.en: 【Belong to Liu Shan's Faction and not be Liu Shan, Fei Yi, Jiang Wan, Yang Yi, Li Yan, Wang Ping, Zhang Ni, Wu Ban, or Wu Yi】 or 【Belong to Cao Rui's Faction and not be Cao Rui or Sun Li】

defy.zh: 【<曹叡势力>避免张郃死亡】【<刘禅势力>避免张郃死亡并俘虏张郃】
defy.en: 【<Cao Rui Faction> Prevent the death of Zhang He】【<Liu Shan Faction> Prevent the death of Zhang He and take Zhang He captive】

force.zh: 刘禅身为君主并占领城市<成都><汉中><武都>
force.en: Liu Shan is a Ruler and occupies the Cities <Chengdu><Hanzhong><Wudu>

force.zh: 曹叡身为君主并占领城市<洛阳><长安><天水>
force.en: Cao Rui is Ruler and occupies City <Luoyang><Chang'an><Tianshui>
Zhuge Liang returns to Liu Shan's Faction.

force.zh: 司马懿、张郃回归曹叡势力
force.en: Sima Yi and Zhang He return to Cao Rui's Faction.
